gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Tests for {@link HexDump}, which renders a byte array as a human-readable hexadecimal dump (offset column, 16 hex byte columns, then an ASCII gutter).
ADDED i3: A 17-byte array (one full 16-byte row plus a single trailing byte) with a non-zero byte (0x7F, a non-printable control character) at position 5 should be dumped
ADDED i4: 0x7F: not printable, so it appears as '.' in the gutter
ADDED i5: A 17-byte array with a printable byte (0x48 = 'H') at position 0 should be dumped with that byte shown in hex and rendered as 'H' in the ASCII gutter.
ADDED i6: 0x48: the printable ASCII character 'H'
ADDED i7: Requesting a length that runs past the end of the array (index 8 + length 101 on a 9-byte array) should fail with ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException for the out-of-
ADDED i9: A negative length (-186) should fail with ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
ADDED i11: A starting index (127) beyond the array's bounds should fail with ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException reporting the illegal index, regardless of the requested length
ADDED i13: A negative starting index (-1) should fail with ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException reporting the illegal index.
ADDED i15: The (deprecated) public constructor is exercised for coverage; HexDump is otherwise a static-only utility class.
ADDED i16: The convenience two-argument dump should write the whole array to the Appendable without modifying the source array.
